findings.finding: The three registered R10 calculations succeeded with inputs unchanged (receipts: family_mean_budget4 9564c81e21aeabc47d2a22c95598c45f94ecddd79ef895a71c936bffa91e1c1c; pooled credit 3ddd75260f43fd04a9fcdcf461ed754c074c26bd5ce76f97fc8ea883b8981cfd; path coverage 7175bd2682b35d6b773d24953ea54184eae10275510a405e0c5a13f9bcade3b7). Budget four yielded 1,821 selected teacher records across 714 batch-events; event teacher counts 1/2/3/4 were 225/146/68/275. At tail weight 0.25, 483 records had nonzero final-tail fraction; batch-equal mean tail fraction was 0.056836 and mean component change was zero. Tail denominator includes all observed terminal offspring slots, including invalid decoded offspring; the weighted utility is heuristic, not calibrated affinity or native success probability.

Observed exact-copy-family coverage averaged 0.892463 of elite graphs and 0.875919 of elite slots, versus 0.803922 and 0.786152 in the prior budget-two diagnostic. At the final event it was 0.697917 graph / 0.625 slot, versus 0.526042 / 0.484375. This retrospective identity coverage remains incomplete and does not show a causal affinity gain.

The baseline provenance hashes differ, but no runtime numerical confound was found. In family_mean mode the code uses baseline discovery batches, landmarks/origin, feature definitions/scales and metadata; teacher coordinates are built from the same bound predicted_coords and labels. Static consumed fields and metrics hashes match; ancestor labels (35,700×17), event effects (54,264×4) and trends are exactly equal to family_mean_v2. The 1,203 shared teacher identities match in all non-prior fields; only per-event normalized logweights change with teacher count. The metadata hash difference is not a separate numerical axis.

R09 had mixed paired differences versus R08 (-0.063744, +0.068740; mean +0.002498), with all mean pIC50 7.62464, valid mean 7.64147 (93/100), p90 strain 1.60394, and one unique valid elite (max 8.47479). Versus native both batches were positive (+0.007809, +0.191218), but this is exploratory two-batch evidence; lower validity and the single maximum argue against promotion. Keep R06 fallback. The current R10 packet verifies calculators, not an R10 compiled reward/VJP or generation outcome.
